rationale_summary: Fundamental rights is the dominant frame because this follow-up notice and Q&A was specifically issued to reinforce privacy and patient-rights guardrails: it emphasizes that medical information is highly sensitive 'special-care personal information' (要配慮個人情報) whose re-identification poses a direct risk of rights infringement (権利侵害), circumscribes permissible joint-use and onward-transfer boundaries under APPI, and requires informed-consent opt-out procedures. Fundamental rights edges out innovation enablement because the document's primary corrective function is tightening scope boundaries and legal-compliance caution rather than expanding data access. Innovation enablement is a strong secondary frame, characterizing medical data as a precious social resource whose appropriate use advances medical science and AI medical-device R&D for current and future generations. Social stability is a clear supporting rationale through the stated objective of securing collective social trust (社会的な信頼の確保) and public/clinical understanding around secondary medical-data utilization.

evidence_spans.quote: 機微性が高く、特定の個人が識別された場合に権利侵害につながるリスクがあることから、これまで「医療分野における仮名加工情報の保護と利活用に関する検討会」、「医療等情報の二次利用に関するワーキンググループ」等において、慎重な取扱いの必要性や、本人、国民、医療現場及び医療情報の利活用に関わる者の理解促進について丁寧に議論されてきた
evidence_spans.quote_en: Because medical information is highly sensitive and carries the risk of infringing rights if a specific individual is identified, the necessity of careful handling and promoting understanding among patients, the public, medical sites, and data users has been carefully discussed in expert study groups and working groups.

evidence_spans.quote: 医療情報は、一般的に、個人情報保護法上の個人データに該当する上、同法上の要配慮個人情報にも該当し、極めて機微な性質を有していることから、個人情報保護法で規定する仮名加工情報を作成し、運用するにあたって不可欠である実践的な指針として、
evidence_spans.quote_en: Because medical information generally falls under personal data and special-care personal information under the Act on the Protection of Personal Information and possesses an extremely sensitive nature, the guideline was created as an indispensable practical guide for creating and operating pseudonymized information stipulated under APPI.

evidence_spans.quote: 医療情報はその適切な活用により医学の発展に寄与し、その成果は現世代だけでなく将来世代にも還元が期待される点で貴重な社会資源である
evidence_spans.quote_en: Through its appropriate utilization, medical information contributes to the advancement of medical science and is a precious social resource whose benefits are expected to be returned not only to the current generation but also to future generations.

evidence_spans.quote: また、医療情報の利活用に対する社会的な信頼の確保に貢献することを目的として本ガイドラインが作成されたところであり、
evidence_spans.quote_en: Furthermore, this guideline was created with the purpose of contributing to securing social trust in the utilization of medical information.
